acceptance_criteria: For a part, these arrays are "ID arrays": top-level `sketches`, `features` and `bodies`, and each sketch's `entities` and `constraints`. An array that is absent is fine. Every element of an ID array must be an object with a non-empty string `id`, and IDs must be unique within that array.

Two new documented `FormatError` variants: one for a missing, empty or non-string `id` (naming the array, e.g. `sketches[0].constraints`, and the element index), one for a duplicate `id` (naming the array and the ID). Their `Display` texts are tested. Nothing panics on bad input.

Writing (both forms) checks IDs before anything is written: on error no file or folder is created. On success, `sketches`, `bodies`, and each sketch's `entities` and `constraints` are written sorted by `id` in byte order (the same order the canonical writer uses for keys; `"e10"` sorts before `"e2"`). `features` keep their given order. The caller's `Document` is not modified.
Reading (both forms) checks IDs the same way and returns the error; it does not reorder anything.

Tests: the golden `crates/swx-io/tests/golden/bracket.sltwx/` still reads and round-trips byte-identically in both forms; a part with `bodies` given as `b-2, b-1` and `entities` given as `e2, e10, e1` is written as `b-1, b-2` and `e1, e10, e2`; two features given as `ft-b, ft-a` stay in that order; a duplicate body ID, an entity without `id` and an `id` of `5` each give the right error from both writers and both readers, with nothing written.
Assemblies and drawings are unchanged (no ID checks yet), shown by an existing or new test.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
objective.description: M4-01f: swx-io: stable IDs in a part's model.json: required, unique, and set arrays sorted by id on write
